changes.title: Sounds landing stir picnic
items: A 💌 that misses lands on the ground with a soft puff
When home's boot-up ends, the forest stirs: a low swell and far bells waking
Home's meadow has its balloons squeaking in the breeze and a picnic's cups clinking and far-off murmur

changes.title: Legend lob beam
items: A legend's long-range lob and beam now have their own effects art: a target circle, the stone in flight and its slam ring, and the long beam
Lobbed shots land with a thud, a legend's with a deep boom

changes.title: Creature texture
items: The boar evolves: a striped piglet, a heavy-fronted adult with a shoulder hump, a mane and curving tusks, and a massive legend with huge curling tusks, flame wisps and a shaggy mane
Creatures have fur, feathers, scales, plates, shells and bristles shaping their light (add ?texture=0 to compare)
